subject.title: fix(ai): record token usage on Responses early-abort (#100954)

question: Should this external provider-accounting PR require a real OpenAI or Azure `response.incomplete` run before merge, or may the exact-event processor tests receive a narrow proof override?
rationale: Repository policy makes after-fix real behavior proof a merge gate for external runtime PRs, while only an assigned reviewer can intentionally accept the narrower SDK-contract evidence instead.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Capture redacted terminal output or logs from the same low-token Responses request on main and this branch, including terminal event type, usage buckets, and computed cost.

options.title: Approve a narrow override
options.body: Accept the SDK contract and processor regressions for server-generated incomplete responses, but explicitly narrow the PR scope and leave the cancellation/timeout issue open unless separately proven.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Capture redacted terminal output or logs from the same low-token Responses request on main and this branch, including terminal event type, usage buckets, and computed cost.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the assigned reviewer and the discussion explicitly directs the remaining proof decision to them.
